# Dora

[Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables)

## Overview

- **Age:** six or seven years old  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000)</sub>
- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v2 I An Irate Neighbor P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P5](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0005), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P6](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0006), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P47](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0047)</sub>

## Appearance

Dora is a neat and proper girl with gentle, mild hazel eyes, a straight nose, and long sleek curls that are never out of order. She wears a nicely starched white dress with a black sash, consistently appearing as prim and tidy as if she had just been starched and ironed.

_Sources: [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P44](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0044)_

## Personality

Dora is a gentle, mild, and lovely child who is widely considered well-behaved, quiet, and a model of good behavior. Characterized as prim, proper, and demure, she generally speaks only when spoken to and keeps silent otherwise. She is industrious, neat, faithful, and observant, never needing to be told how to do a task twice and never forgetting her duties. In her work, such as planting and weeding, she acts carefully, systematically, and dispassionately. She approaches her studies meekly, reciting like a little machine, and remains composed even when pale.

_Sources: [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P30](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0030), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P44](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0044), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P85](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0085), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P88](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0088), +8 more_

## History

Dora went to live at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), where [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) cared for her alongside her rambunctious twin, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md). Her quiet routine involved starting school and being taken to town by [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md). Following the death of [Richard Keith](../character/richard-keith.md), a trust fund was left for Dora and [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md), allowing them to permanently remain at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables).

_Sources: [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P12](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0012), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P17](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0017), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P22](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0022), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P26](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0026), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P1](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0001), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P22](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0022), +10 more_

## Relationships

### [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/davy-keith--dora.md)

Dora is the twin sister of [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md). [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) frequently torments her, such as snatching her cake at supper and locking her in Mr. Harrison's toolhouse while lying about her whereabouts. Despite his unruly behavior toward her and the extra supervision required to keep him in line, they share daily home and school routines under [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and Marilla's care.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P30](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0030), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P10](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0010), +27 more_

- Sibling of — twin sister  <sub>[v2 I An Irate Neighbor P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P30](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0030), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P10](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0010), +7 more</sub>

### [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/dora--paul-irving.md)

Dora and [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) are childhood friends who like one another. They share outings together alongside [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), and [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md), including a pleasant day spent rowing on the water.

_Sources: [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P1](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0001), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P15](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0015), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P20](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0020), +2 more_
